race.description: Lakes Diesel Sales & Service Mdn Plate
race.comment: KOORALBYN (14) just battled on debut when well found in the market, and he cops a wide gate here, but whenever the Moody/Coleman stable trek to this track, they are usually very confident of coming away with a win, so stick with this gelding on top. GENKI GIRL (15) has yet to fire on race day, but her recent jump-out form says she has improved a lot, and with more maturity on her side, she can give this a big shake, especially from her good gate. NISHIOKA (12) makes her debut with some strong jump-out form behind her. She has a perfect gate, and will no doubt be ready to run a big race if she is not too green. Check the market. HEAVY IS THE HEAD (3) resumes from a spell and looked in good shape when winning a recent Moe Jump-out earlier in the month. Keep her very safe.
